q: treatment of hydatid cyst
a:
• Chemotherapy if surgery is contraindicated,

If large nr. Of cysts
If more than one organ affected
Contraindications: toxicity of drug, useless in complic. + dead cysts, pregnancy, chr. Hep disease, bone marrow suppression

  • PAIR: US guided, scolicidal agent is injected + reaspired after 15 min than its filled with istonic saline solution

Peroop albendazole prophylaxis:risk of local seeding
Contraindic: gharbi 5, complic CE and superficial CE
Surgery is indicated in most cases

  • Total pericystectomy (lagrot)

Removal of parasite and whole pericyst
Increased risk of hemorrhage, shorter postop outcome

  • Hepatic resection

Avoids risk of seeding, more aggressive cause removes healthy tissue, for large cysts

  • Cystectomy with partial pericystectomy

Removes also parasite and pericyst and most frequent used

  • Marsupidisation

Absolute technique, suture edges of pericyst to abd wall (sterilization of parasite, removal and reduction of residual cavity)
Agents: hypertonic saline sol., chlorhexidine, cetrimide sol
